(and “unless”, “provided that”) Causal:…

The tool builds two labeled directed graphs from the prompt + candidate: *Gₚ* (premises) and *G𝒸* (candidate answer). Nodes encode entities; edges encode relational predicates (e.g., *cause*, *greater‑than*, *¬*).

synthesis.excerpt: Combining thermodynamics, phase transitions, and compressed sensing leads to a Free‑Energy‑Driven Approximate Message Passing (FE‑AMP) inference engine.
design Proposition extraction – For each candidate answer and a reference answer, run a deterministic regex‑based parser that yields a list of atomic propositions *pᵢ*.

Parse each prompt and candidate answer into a set of grounded literals L=\{l_1,\dots,l_m\} using regex‑based pattern extraction for: causal atoms X\rightarrow Y (from “because”, “leads to”, “if … then”) pragmatic atoms \text{Imp}(p,q) (implicature triggered by scalar terms, politeness markers,…

Hierarchical Value‑Iteration Policy Gradient (HIV‑PG) Data structures Prompt & candidate answers are parsed into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) where nodes are *linguistic chunks* (tokens, noun‑phrases, verb‑phrases, clauses) and edges represent syntactic dependencies (subject‑verb, modifier‑head,…

Parsing → Boolean literals – Extract atomic propositions from the candidate answer and a reference answer using regex patterns for negations (not), comparatives (>, <, >=, <=), conditionals (if … then …), and causal arrows (because, leads to). Each proposition becomes a Boolean variable x_i.
